nodes.label: Funding
nodes.data: Zepto raised $340M in a Series F round in Nov 2024 led by Motilal Oswal and General Catalyst, pushing its valuation to roughly $5B, with prior backers including Nexus Venture Partners and Y Combinator.

nodes.label: People
nodes.data: Rapidly scaling operations and category-management teams as dark-store count expands past 700+ locations across major Indian metros, with continued leadership hiring in supply chain and category expansion.

nodes.label: Product
nodes.data: 10-minute grocery delivery via a dark-store network, expanding into Zepto Cafe (quick-commerce food and beverage) and private-label grocery brands to improve margins.

nodes.label: Threat
nodes.data: Heavy capital backing and rapid dark-store expansion are compressing delivery-time expectations market-wide, pressuring competitors to match speed and density or lose share in metro markets.

nodes.label: Your Move
nodes.data: Focus on dark-store density in defensible metro pockets and lean into private-label margin capture rather than competing purely on delivery speed.

threatBrief: Zepto is aggressively capitalized and expanding dark-store density and category breadth, raising the bar on delivery speed across the quick-commerce market. Its move into private-label and adjacent categories (Cafe) signals an effort to improve unit economics while maintaining growth pace.
gtmMoves: Prioritize dark-store density in high-defensibility metro pockets rather than broad national coverage
Accelerate private-label rollout to protect margins against Zepto's cost pressure
Differentiate on curated assortment or service quality rather than competing head-on for delivery speed
